# webhook-handler
> Secure webhook receiver with HMAC-SHA256 verification and idempotency

Secure webhook receiver with HMAC-SHA256 signature verification, idempotency via request ID caching, and timestamp tolerance to prevent replay attacks. ```typescript import { WebhookHandler } from 'webhook-handler';

## API
- `WebhookEvent`
- `WebhookHandler`
